purpose: A service that processes payment requests, tracks payment status, and interacts with acquirers to facilitate transactions.

components.name: edge
components.evidence: Payments Edge Gateway, the PEG or just the edge depending on who you ask

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: the core or the payments service

components.name: acquirer connector
components.evidence: calls the acquirer through the acquirer connector

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: publishes an event to payment-events, the Kafka topic

flows.evidence: the edge passes the validated request to payments-core
the core writes the payment to payments-db
the core publishes an event to payment-events, the Kafka topic
